build_texture_atlas_loader: build a python module to load a texture atlas image from a file path and convert BGR to RGB
create_visualizer_with_texture: create a DensePoseResultsVisualizerWithTexture instance initialized with a texture atlas numpy array
visualize_densepose_with_texture: visualize DensePose chart results on a BGR image by overlaying texture atlas data onto detected body parts
extract_texture_grid: extract a 24-part texture grid from the atlas and compute alpha channels for blending
generate_textured_image: generate an image with texture overlay by mapping UV coordinates to texture atlas regions for each body part
